coverage_limits: The root benchmark_results map_*_required JSONs are small synthetic compatibility cases, not real-SMACS quality measurements.
Archived real-SMACS response and catalog-detection reports cover selected SWarp, Drizzle, and Torchsky bilinear/Lanczos variants. No local real-SMACS Montage detection/response report was found.

The published UPdec iter0/iter10 report compares the two products after analytic linear-TAN bilinear alignment; it is a product-pair diagnostic, not common-truth depth or detector-likelihood evidence.
The three fixed 512×512 injection manifests are independent 28-source six-band batches. Brightest-injection manifests are derived subsets, not independent batches.
No metric is assigned from quicklook appearance, image smoothness, or unstored remote products.
deduplication: shared-foam JSON is grouped by byte-identical SHA256; model configuration signatures use saved fields; the three validation source manifests remain distinct.

metric_categories.qualification: Reference-relative fit/residual diagnostics; not independent truth metrics.
Present only where validation_detector_scoring was included.

notes: Older shared-foam reports often preserve step counts and learning rates but omit optimizer algorithm identity; this inventory marks that as unrecorded.
`linear_band_grid_field` effective kwargs record CG solver metadata; its solver iteration count is not an Adam update count.

October 10 INR manifests distinguish Adam initialization from optional neural-PCG refinement. Repeated r1-r5 specs are launch/config retries; recovered metrics are identified separately by artifact path.
